Amanda C: Heads up — offer accepted for Carlos B, converting from contractor -> FT. Start Mon 03/30. Background vendor returned a duplicate-SSN flag and passport name mismatch (middle initial). Need I-9 plan + benefits retro enrollment. Who can own?
Kelly (People Ops): @raj please triage background vendor, @IT Ops we may need prior contractor record. I'll prep benefits packet and add hold on enrollment until cleared. :eyes:
Raj P: On it. Vendor (Checkr) notes duplicate SSN match to record id 8721 from 2021 contractor cohort. Could be same person under different email. I'll open an investigation ticket and request human review.
PeopleBot: Quick reference — if employee is rehire within 3 years, Section 3 of I-9 can be used; otherwise complete new I-9. Remote verification allowed with authorized agent or remote-notary doc + scanned copies per policy. See policy link: https://intra.redwood/handbook/i9
Amanda C: thanks. Carlos's contractor end date was 2022-11-15 so >3 years. That implies a new I-9. However vendor says possible duplicate SSN match so they want in-person verification. Can we do an in-person I-9 at SF satellite next Friday? He is remote in PST.
IT Ops: We can schedule a satellite kiosk slot. Which office? SF Downtown works. I need headcount for escort, parking pass, and laptop pickup. Also confirm shipping hold id: LPT-4987.
Kelly (People Ops): I'll reserve escort (People-ops escorting) and request parking. Amanda can you confirm Carlos can come on Friday 10am PST? I'll also start retro benefits enrollment form: code 'RETRO-FT-30' for payroll.
Amanda C: Confirmed with candidate — Friday 10am SF. I'll send calendar invite and copy of docs to bring: passport + SSN card OR passport + original driver's license. Also instruct to bring previous contractor badge if available.
Raj P: Update from Checkr — human reviewer flagged the duplicate as low-confidence. They've requested a photo of the SSN card + a signed attestation. I'll add that to the vendor thread.
Amanda C: Okay, let's do both: vendor asks for SSN card photo and we have in-person I-9 as fallback. If vendor clears remotely before Friday, we can do remote I-9. Please add calendar placeholder: /cal invite "Carlos B — I-9 & orientation" Fri 10:00-10:30 AM PDT @SF-Downtown. @IT Ops add parking pass.
IT Ops: Parking pass requested. Also laptop LPT-4987 on hold; courier to release only after HR check-in. Courier Service Bot: Hold acknowledged — will not deliver until 'HR CLEARED' tag.
Kelly (People Ops): Adding benefits note — payroll needs retro code and signed enrollment. Amanda, please collect signed benefits waiver & enrollment on day 1. I'll submit e-form: ENROLL/RETRO with candidate email.
Amanda C: Will collect and scan into Workday; planning day-1 agenda: 9:30 check-in w/ People Ops, 10:00 I-9 verification, 11:00 laptop handoff + IT walkthru, 1:00 benefits overview. Ping if anything changes. :thumbsup:
